questions.program:

questions.question: In the 2021-22 school year, which state achieved a higher graduation rate for English learners: Texas or California?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nces_digest_graduation_rates_by_state.xlsx', sheet_name='Digest 2023 Table 219.46', header=None)
tx_val = float(df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Texas'].iloc[0, 42])
ca_val = float(df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'California'].iloc[0, 42])
result = 'Texas' if tx_val > ca_val else 'California'

questions.question: Which three states had the highest overall public high school graduation rates in the 2021-22 school year?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nces_digest_graduation_rates_by_state.xlsx', sheet_name='Digest 2023 Table 219.46', header=None)
state_df = df.iloc[7:58, [0, 15]].copy()
state_df[0] = state_df[0].astype(str).str.replace(r'\\\d+', '', regex=True).str.strip()
state_df[15] = pd.to_numeric(state_df[15], errors='coerce')
top3 = state_df.dropna().sort_values(by=15, ascending=False).head(3)
result = list(top3[0])
questions.check_program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nces_digest_graduation_rates_by_state.xlsx', sheet_name='Digest 2023 Table 219.46', header=None)
# Rows 7 to 57 are states and DC (Excel rows 8 to 58)
state_df = df.iloc[7:58, [0, 15]].copy()

state_df[15] = pd.to_numeric(state_df[15], errors='coerce')
top3 = state_df.sort_values(by=15, ascending=False).head(3)
result = [str(x).strip() for x in top3[0].tolist()]

questions.question: How many states (excluding the District of Columbia and other jurisdictions) had an overall public high school graduation rate of 90 percent or higher in the 2021-22 school year?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nces_digest_graduation_rates_by_state.xlsx', sheet_name='Digest 2023 Table 219.46', header=None)
state_df = df.iloc[7:58, [0, 15]].copy()
state_df = state_df[~state_df[0].astype(str).str.contains('District of Columbia')]
vals = pd.to_numeric(state_df[15], errors='coerce')
result = int((vals >= 90).sum())

questions.question: Did the national overall public high school graduation rate increase from the 2020-21 school year to the 2021-22 school year?
questions.program:

us_row = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'United States'].iloc[0]
rate_20_21 = float(us_row[13])
rate_21_22 = float(us_row[15])
result = 'yes' if rate_21_22 > rate_20_21 else 'no'
